title: Default lookup after appending one element
statement: For a list $l$ and elements $a,d$ of its type, the function that looks up position $e$ in the list formed by appending $a$ to $l$, using default $d$, is the function that looks up position $e$ in $l$ with the same default, except that its value at position $|l|$ is replaced by $a$.
